A4Analogue

ADSR

Envelope generator with three modes

Envelope generator with attack, decay, sustain and release. The CV input controls either the sustain level or all time settings.

  • Times from about 1 ms to 25 s
  • LOOP, ADSR and AR modes
  • Output 0 … 8 V
